title.zh: 完整流程：成核只是第一步
title.en: Full process: nucleation is only the first step

subtitle.zh: Mandrel 形成 / Spacer 沉积 / 拉除 / Cut 与转移
subtitle.en: Mandrel formation / spacer deposition / removal / cut and transfer

body.zh: 01 光刻定义 Mandrel：以光刻胶或可刻蚀材料形成图形。02 Mandrel 刻蚀：去除多余材料。03 共形沉积 Spacer：覆盖顶面、两侧壁及暴露水平面。
body.en: 01 Lithographically define mandrels in resist or etchable material. 02 Etch mandrels, removing excess material. 03 Conformally deposit spacer over tops, both sidewalls, and exposed horizontal surfaces.

body.zh: 04 各向异性 Spacer 刻蚀：去除水平向 Spacer，保留侧墙。05 选择性移除 Mandrel：留下两条 Spacer，形成双倍频图形。06 Cut/Block 删除多余线段或定义线端，并转移到硬掩膜/目标层。
body.en: 04 Anisotropically etch horizontal spacer material while retaining sidewalls. 05 Selectively remove mandrels, leaving two spacers and a doubled pattern. 06 Use cut/block to remove unwanted segments or define line ends, then transfer to hard mask/target.

body.zh: Mandrel 侧壁轮廓决定后续 Spacer 厚度与位置。Spacer 要良好共形，均匀覆盖顶面与侧壁。Spacer 刻蚀需清除水平膜并保证侧墙形貌与尺寸。Mandrel 拉除需选择性移除核心，不损伤 Spacer 与下层。
body.en: Mandrel sidewall profile sets subsequent spacer thickness/position. Spacer deposition must conformally and uniformly cover tops/sidewalls. Etching must clear horizontal film while preserving sidewall shape/dimensions. Mandrel removal must protect spacer and underlying layers.

body.zh: 水平膜去除充分 ↔ 侧墙损失：清除不足会有顶部残留，过刻会损失侧墙。Mandrel 完全拉除 ↔ 保护 Spacer 与下层：拉除不完全会残留，过度氧化/刻蚀会损伤 Spacer 或下层。
body.en: Complete horizontal-film removal ↔ sidewall loss: insufficient clearing leaves top residue; overetch removes sidewall material. Complete mandrel removal ↔ spacer/underlayer protection: incomplete removal leaves residue; excess oxidation/etch damages spacer or lower layers.

body.zh: 风险表现包括顶帽或残留、Footing、Mandrel 残留、Spacer 变薄与转移偏差。
body.en: Risk signatures include top caps/residue, footing, mandrel residue, spacer thinning, and transfer bias.

body.zh: SADP 是连续整合链，前段轮廓误差会带入后续转移。量测 Mandrel CD、Spacer 轮廓、拉除残留、最终 CD，以截面检查各阶段。反馈：分段复测 → Hold → 锁定误差首次出现节点。Cut/Block 插入顺序与硬掩膜堆栈随整合方案变化。
body.en: SADP is a continuous integration chain; early profile errors propagate into later transfer. Measure mandrel CD, spacer profiles, removal residue, and final CD with stage-by-stage cross-sections. Feedback: remeasure stages → hold → identify the first appearance of error. Cut/block sequence and hard-mask stack depend on integration.
